project_title: DNA-based sensors for small molecules and proteins
scientific_task: Collect and standardize experimentally reported quantitative performance measurements of DNA-based sensors, including DNA probes, DNA aptamer sensors, DNAzyme sensors, molecular beacons, and related nucleic-acid sensing systems, for detecting small molecules, ions, proteins, biomarkers, and related analytes. The dataset will be used to compare sensor designs and identify which sensing architectures are associated with higher sensitivity, wider linear range, and better target selectivity.

record_definition.one_record: One experimentally reported quantitative sensing-performance measurement for one DNA-based sensor design detecting one target analyte under a defined assay condition from a single literature, supplementary, database, or web source.
